observation: VoiceOutcome.create() validates lineage against the concrete VoiceSessionCapsule before construction.

VoiceOutcome.from_mapping() reconstructs and validates a self-consistent VoiceOutcome but cannot by itself prove that the embedded voice_session_id/voice_session_sha256 and outcome causal lineage correspond to the concrete session currently being consumed.
bind_voice_outcome(session=..., candidate=...) is the existing exact consumer-boundary validator: it checks exact session id/digest, causal lineage and divergent terminal-outcome replay.

The generic VoiceOutcome schema does not prohibit result_ref/result_sha256 solely because outcome_kind is INTERRUPTED; the stricter Trigger7 heard-prefix policy therefore must be enforced by the cortex integration adapter rather than assumed from the generic voice contract.

VSR01_COMPLETED_HEARD_OUTPUT_REENTRY.require: Before any VoiceOutcome contributes to next-turn context, memory binding or replay identity, consume it through bind_voice_outcome() against the exact VoiceSessionCapsule. VoiceOutcome.from_mapping() or an outcome digest alone is insufficient consumer evidence.

VSR02_INTERRUPTED_HEARD_PREFIX_EPHEMERAL.require: Even if a syntactically valid INTERRUPTED VoiceOutcome carries result_ref/result_sha256, the cortex adapter must reject that result as durable output/memory authority under the resolved Trigger7 interruption policy. Only the separately measured heard-prefix payload may enter ephemeral next-turn dialogue context, with the unheard tail excluded.

VSR06_RESTART_REPLAY_IDEMPOTENCE.require: Replay must call bind_voice_outcome() with the recovered exact session and previously bound outcome. Exact identical replay is idempotent; a different terminal outcome for the same session or an outcome from a different session must fail closed.

new_negative_discriminators.setup: Construct/recover a self-consistent VoiceOutcome whose embedded session identity is not the exact active VoiceSessionCapsule, then present it to the cortex integration boundary.
new_negative_discriminators.require: Fail closed through bind_voice_outcome(); no context, memory, GWT, tool/effect or replay admission follows.

new_negative_discriminators.setup: For one exact VoiceSessionCapsule, persist/recover one accepted terminal VoiceOutcome, then present a different terminal candidate for the same session.
new_negative_discriminators.require: Fail closed; exact identical replay alone is idempotent.

new_negative_discriminators.setup: Create a schema-valid OUTCOME_INTERRUPTED carrying result_ref/result_sha256 and pair it with an interrupted packet whose heard_fraction is between 0 and 1.
new_negative_discriminators.require: The cortex integration policy rejects the result_ref/result_sha256 as durable VoiceOutcome/memory authority; only an independently measured exact heard-prefix payload may be admitted ephemerally.

whole_loop_boundary_note.rule: Do not route around the voice/session binding by treating VoiceOutcome references as generic whole-loop reentry refs. Existing WP900/WP206 persistence integration binds its own sealed checkpoint identities and is not a substitute for exact VoiceOutcome-to-VoiceSession validation. Reuse it only after the voice-specific adapter has produced admitted typed evidence at its proper boundary.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 consumes this addendum with the existing VSR01-VSR06 and ContextCostWitness addendum, implements only the smallest existing-boundary adapter/harness, and includes VSR07-VSR09 in the same single VPS integration discriminator run rather than opening a new voice component or runtime dispatch.
